messages:
Joanne CSM: Heads-up — HarmonicAI activation health trending worse this week. Mid-day p95 spikes, some 5xxs during bursts, and renewal signal just moved to yellow. I ran a quick perf digest: their summarization endpoint dominates tokens and latency. I want to propose a proactive perf plan: an int8 quant swap for the summarizer model + split routing (short inputs -> compact model; long inputs -> standard model with KV caching). Can we coordinate a low-risk canary?

Amir Eng: +1 on canary. For HarmonicAI the summarizer has predictable short/long split (<=128 tokens short). We can create a route that pins short requests to redwood/summarizer-compact-int8 and long ones to redwood/summarizer-std. I expect ~35% cost down and p95 latency ~30% better for short requests. Will prepare config & canary command.

Sylvie ML: Nice. Two things to watch: quality drift on abstractive summaries and prefix cache behavior for conversation contexts. Suggest adding a tiny eval set (200 examples) pulled from their prod prompts to run pre/post canary. Also add a KV warm-start for their session tokens to minimize cold-start tail latency.

Kevin Platform: Plan for rollout: 1) Stage build in staging with same traffic mix. 2) Canary at 3% of production traffic for 2 hours, monitor p95, p99, error-rate, and rouge/bleu-ish proxy (Sylvie's eval). 3) If green, ramp to 25% for 6 hours, then 100% after a successful night window. Canary SLO gates: p95 decrease or <= baseline + 10ms, error-rate <= 0.5% absolute increase, quality delta <= 1.5% relative. I can create the canary in the console and wire alerts.

Joanne CSM: Thanks — I'll draft a short customer note that this is a non-disruptive perf experiment to avoid surprises. Can we get the minimal one-pager (what's changing, expected benefit, rollback plan) by EOD? Renewal touchpoint scheduled in 5 days so we need to be quick.

Amir Eng: Putting a quick routing snippet below for config. We'll run canary on the dedicated pool with autoscale off for the test window.

```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"name": "short-summarizer", "match": "input_tokens <= 128", "model": "redwood/summarizer-compact-int8", "weight": 3},
    {"name": "long-summarizer", "match": "input_tokens > 128", "model": "redwood/summarizer-std", "weight": 1}
  ],
  "canary": {"percent": 3, "duration_minutes": 120}
}
```

Rollback/patch commands:
```bash
# create canary
rwctl routes apply -f harmonicai-routing.json --canary 3
# rollback
rwctl routes rollback harmonicai-routing --to previous
```

OnboardBot: Scheduled canary: HarmonicAI /summarize route at 2026-04-09T14:00Z (3% traffic, 2h). Monitoring: perf-alerts, quality-evals. @Joanne CSM, set calendar reminder? :calendar:

Sylvie ML: I'll kick off the eval harness right after canary starts and post a small report. Key metrics: summary ROUGE-L proxy, hallucination rate (heuristic), and average length change. If ROUGE drops >1.5% we'll fail canary.

Kevin Platform: I've reserved a small dedicated slice (2 GPUs) for the canary and disabled burst autoscale to keep the experiment stable. I'll link the dashboard once live.

Joanne CSM: Perfect — can you both drop the short customer note in this thread so I can copy-edit? Also tag me when canary goes green so I can tell the CS owner. :thumbsup:

Amir Eng: Dropping a 2-line note for customer outreach: "We will run a brief performance trial that routes short summaries to a compact, quantized model to reduce latency and cost. There is a rollback plan and we will monitor quality metrics closely. Expected improvement: ~30% faster p95 on short requests."

Sylvie ML: I'll add the eval summary template link: https://redwood.console/evals/harmonicai/summarizer (results posted after canary).

Kevin Platform: Ack. Owners: Amir (deploy + rollback), Sylvie (quality), Joanne (customer comms). OnboardBot: please ping #renewals if canary status flips to red.

Joanne CSM: Thanks team — let's aim to have canary report and customer note ready before the renewal call.

-- thread end --
